text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 higher in old crop July to C$412.50 a tonne and C$1.50 up in new crop November at C$383.50 on CBOT soycomplex calls, consolidating after Tuesday's sharp break, short covering and heavy snow in north Alberta stalling deliveries and seeding. Current price levels may entice Mexican demand. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -2.35 Wednesday from -4.75 Tuesday. Canada's dollar was weaker at C$1.3711 versus the U.S. dollar, rose to 84.44 Japanese Yen and fell to 1.2335 German Marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.90-C$1.40 up in old crop July on allied markets and a lack of hedges.

WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.30 to C$0.80 up on CBOT corn calls and expectations The Canadian Wheat Board will issue a higher world barley price forecast in its May Pool Return Outlook Thursday at 1400 CDT/1900 GMT. Alberta farmers' ability to deliver or seed barley was hindered by heavy snowfall.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 higher on calls in U.S. wheat markets.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
